text: What was done and when, latest first.
On paper: D5=γ5 when Q/γ2 has at most one invariant larger than 3 (including C9× C3s-1); an independent review found no errors.
References: what Tahara actually announced (p. 173), and the search for his separate paper.
Computer check for C9× C3s-1 and C27,C81× C3s-1: 2 057 groups, 4 537 elements z, none in D5.
ANUPQ audit (ispacex.github.io/gap): the 39 descendant step was repeated with the fixed version, and the result is byte-identical.
On paper: Dn(H E)=Dn(H) for central products with D8, Q8 and M2k+2 (adjoining a central square root); all 386 candidates of orders 26–29 satisfy the conditions. Two independent reviews.
The group analogue of Theorem C: D7=1 for the plateau group; the first search at c=4; at c=5, D7≠1 but D8∩γ5=1.
Order 38: the full scan, 904 non-metabelian groups, D5=1 in all.
Order 39: the p-cover filter, 62 245 candidates, D5=1 in all; rank 5 excluded on paper.
On paper: D5=γ5 for Q/γ2 of exponent 3; the Lie-ring lemma; P*=1. Two independent line-by-line reviews.
Order 210 closed: the minimal-counterexample lemma, ANUPQ, 3400 candidates.
Lossless pruning of the 2-group tree for 211; ranks 2–3 and ≥8 closed.
Exact computation of Dn for small p-groups: all 2-groups up to 27, 28 of class ≥3, metabelian 29 of class 3, 3-groups up to 36.
Tahara's bound checked against the original; no 3-torsion up to 37 (Gupta–Tahara).
Truncated Magnus algebra: quotients of Rips-type groups, D4≠1 at 284, 290, 2107 proved, D5=1.
The Lean formalization of Ionin–Mikhailov–Petrov audited (build, axioms).
Group dimension subgroups in Lean: γn⊆ Dn, D2=γ2, the D5 question stated.
Paper draft: the reduction to 2-groups of class 3; where the Lie-ring proof does not transfer.
